title: TapirMasterModels
description: A consolidated, single-file schema for the Archicad Tapir JSON API.

author.description: The author of the new comment.

overwriteExisting.description: Optional. When true, an embedded library item already existing on an outputPath is deleted first, so the newly added file replaces the loaded library part. By default false: the existing loaded part stays in use. Requires Archicad 27 or newer.

libraries.description: Local library folders or container files, by absolute path.

propertyId.description: An existing custom property. Create it first with CreatePropertyDefinitions if needed.

attributeIds.description: The attributes (for example Building Materials) to make the property available for.

AngleType.description: The type of the angle measurement unit.

items.description: The identifier of the element and the name of the Favorite to apply to it.

applySettings.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's settings-type parameters (structure, materials, pens, etc. - never geometry). For the hierarchical types (Stair, Railing, Curtain Wall) the settings of the sub-elements are not applied, because they are inseparable from the Favorite's own geometry. Default is true.

applyClassifications.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's classifications. Default is true.

applyCategories.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's element categories (e.g. IFC categories). Default is true.

applyProperties.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's property values. Default is true.

keepFields.description: Fields of the target element to keep: after the Favorite has been applied, they are copied back from the target as it was before, so only the Favorite's other settings (e.g. its library part or wall type) take effect. 'id' and 'layerIndex' apply to every element type; 'width', 'height' and 'sillHeight' to a Window or Door ('width' and 'height' also to a Skylight); 'height', 'topOffset' and 'relativeTopStory' to a Wall or Column; 'referenceLineLocation' to a Wall. A field the target's type does not have is ignored. To keep a Wall's or Column's top exactly as it was, keep 'height', 'relativeTopStory' and 'topOffset' together - a kept 'height' alone is recomputed by Archicad while the Favorite's relativeTopStory links the top to a story. Default: nothing is kept.

ArcDetails.description: Geometry of an Arc or Circle element. begAngle/endAngle are only present for Arc (a Circle spans the full 0-2*PI range implicitly).

angle.description: 0.0, or the angle of the 'a' axis in radians.

begAngle.description: Beginning angle of the arc in radians. Only present for Arc, not Circle.

endAngle.description: End angle of the arc in radians. Only present for Arc, not Circle.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

ArcSettings.description: Settings for modifying an Arc or Circle. begAngle/endAngle are only applied to Arc, ignored for Circle.

AreaType.description: The type of the area measurement unit.

AssociativeWitnessPoint.description: A witness point of a dimension. Give elementId (with line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus and nodeId as needed) for a point associated with an element, or only coordinate for a static point that is not associated with any element, like a point added by hand on empty space. A witness point takes either elementId or coordinate, not both.

coordinate.description: The position of a static (non-associative) witness point. Use it instead of elementId; the other fields are ignored for a static point.

AttributeCreationInfo.description: How, from where, by whom and when the attribute was created. Available from Archicad 30, and only for an attribute Archicad keeps a creation record of: legacy or imported attributes may have none, and then the field is left out. Any of the texts may be empty.

method.description: The creation method or workflow: AddOn (created by an Add-On), Merge (merging files), Paste (pasting from another file), New (created by the user through the UI), Import (an attribute file, IFC, DWG/DXF or another supported format), Explode (exploding a PDF or DWG), Duplicate (duplicating an attribute), Hotlink (a hotlinked file), XRef (a file attached in the Xref manager), Library (a library part), LibraryMaster (generated from GDL) or Unspecified.

methodDescription.description: Human-readable description of the creation method.

source.description: Human-readable origin, for example the name of the file or Add-On the attribute came from.

creatorUserName.description: The Teamwork user name, or the OS login name in a solo project, at the time of creation.

creationTime.description: The creation time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same scale as modificationTime.

AttributeFolder.description: An attribute folder, identified by the type of the attributes it holds and its path from the root folder of that type. Attribute folders exist from Archicad 26.

path.description: The names of the folders from the root folder down to this folder, the root folder itself not included. An empty array is the root folder.

index.description: Index of the attribute.

name.description: Name of the attribute.

modificationTime.description: The last modification time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same stamp the Attribute Manager writes as ModiTime into its XML export.

AttributeHeadersOrError.description: The response of the GetAttributesByType command or an error.

AttributeHeadersWrapper.description: The response of the GetAttributesByType command.

AttributeIdOrError.description: An attribute identifier or an error.

AttributePropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner attribute.

AttributePropertyValues.description: A list of attribute property values.

name.description: The autotext's display name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

AutoTextNameOrError.description: The display name of one autotext key, or an error.

AutoTextNamesOrErrors.description: One result per input key, in the same order.

referencePosition.description: Reference point to automatically find zone.

vertexIds.description: The outer contour of the face: 0-based indices into vertices.

holes.description: The holes in the face, each a closed loop of 0-based indices into vertices.

surfaceId.description: The surface attribute of the face. Left out when the face's material is not a project attribute (for example one defined by a GDL script).

BoundingBox2D.description: A two-dimensional bounding box defined by its minimum and maximum coordinates.

BoundingBox3D.description: A 3D bounding box of an element.

xMin.description: The minimum X value of the bounding box.

yMin.description: The minimum Y value of the bounding box.

zMin.description: The minimum Z value of the bounding box.

xMax.description: The maximum X value of the bounding box.

yMax.description: The maximum Y value of the bounding box.

zMax.description: The maximum Z value of the bounding box.

BoundingBox3DArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a 3D bounding box.

BoundingBox3DOrError.description: A 3D bounding box or an error.

BuildingMaterialAttributeOrError.description: A building material attribute or an error.

BuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties.description: The physical properties of a single building material.

BuildingMaterialPhysicalPropertiesList.description: A list of building material physical properties

styles.description: The 3D styles to change, identified by their name. Only the given fields change.

name.description: The name of the 3D style, unique within the project.

engineId.description: The id of the 3D rendering engine (API_3DStyle.engineId).

vectorialSunShadow.description: The vectorial sun shadow options, as the integer value of API_VectorShadowID.

vectorialHatchingThickness.description: The thickness of the vectorial hatching, in pixels.

castShadowPercent.description: The intensity of the cast shadows, in percent.

shadingPercent.description: The intensity of the shading, in percent.

shadowElevation.description: The elevation of the shadow plane, used by the one level vectorial sun shadow options.

sourceLocation.description: Absolute path of the new module source file (.mod or .pln).

description.description: The description of the classification system.

version.description: The version of the classification system.

date.description: The release date of the classification system's current version.

viewsData.description: Array of views to clone from the Project Map to the View Map.

navigatorItemId.description: Navigator item ID of the Project Map viewpoint to clone.

parentNavigatorItemId.description: Navigator item ID of the View Map folder to place the clone in. Required - Archicad's CloneProjectMapItemToViewMap API leaves a clone created directly at the View Map root in a broken state (it cannot be deleted or moved afterwards, by API or by hand), so Tapir refuses to fall back to the root on your behalf. Create a View Map folder (CreateViewMapFolder) first if you don't already have one to target.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan. Each pair of consecutive coordinates becomes one straight segment, so two coordinates give a single-segment curtain wall.

zCoordinate.description: Optional Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the bottom of the curtain wall. When omitted, the base level of the favorite (or of the Curtain Wall tool defaults) relative to the floor is kept.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. When omitted, derived from zCoordinate if that is given, otherwise the current story.

height.description: Optional height of the curtain wall. When omitted, the height of the favorite (or of the Curtain Wall tool defaults) is kept.

primaryPattern.description: Optional column pattern: the sizes of the columns along the segment (the primary grid). When omitted, the pattern of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) is kept.

secondaryPattern.description: Optional row pattern: the sizes of the rows from the bottom up (the secondary grid). When omitted, the pattern of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) is kept.

cells.description: Optional assignment of panel and frame classes to the cells of the pattern unit. The unit repeats along and up the segment, so an assignment applies to every repetition of that cell. A cell not listed here keeps the assignment of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) when the pattern is unchanged, otherwise the assignment of the first default cell.

libraryPartName.description: Optional. Localized library part name (docu_UName) to place instead of the tool default/favorite, e.g. a shutter part that has no favorite. It has to be a door library part. Applied to the tool defaults before cloning.

favoriteName.description: Optional. Name of an existing Door favorite (as returned by `GetFavoritesByType`). Applied to the Door tool defaults before the create.

name.description: Custom title name of the new Drawing. Giving a name implies nameType CustomName unless nameType is set explicitly.

nameType.description: Defaults to CustomName when name is given, otherwise to the Drawing tool's current default.

scale.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view (API_DrawingType::ratio). Defaults to 1.0.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

electricalCircuitsData.description: Array of data to create electrical circuits. Each item adds one circuit to the given panel.

electricalPanelId.description: The panel to add the new circuit to.

wiringTypeName.description: One of the wiring types of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

electricalDevicesData.description: Array of data to create electrical devices. The fields that are not given are taken from the default settings of the Electrical Device tool.

position.description: The anchor point of the new device.

orientation.description: Defaults to the direction (1, 0, 0) and the rotation (0, 1, 0).

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

loadClassificationName.description: One of the load classifications of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

circuitId.description: The circuit to connect the new device to.

electricalPanelsData.description: Array of data to create electrical panels. The fields that are not given are taken from the default settings of the Electrical Panel tool.

position.description: The anchor point of the new panel.

orientation.description: Defaults to the direction (1, 0, 0) and the rotation (0, 1, 0).

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

items.description: The identifier of the element and the name of the new favorite.

folder.description: Optional folder hierarchy in the Favorites palette to place the new favorite under. Empty/omitted = root.

fillDataArray.description: Array of data to create new Fills.

items.description: Data to create a Fill.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Fill to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Fill to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Fill with the given name will be overwritten.

subType.description: Vector, Solid, Empty, Symbol, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, or Image. Defaults to Vector. Only one Solid and one Empty fill may exist. Image fills use the texture field's name to reference the image library part.

useForWalls.description: This fill can be used for cut fills.

useForDraft.description: This fill can be used for drafting fills.

useForCover.description: This fill can be used for cover fills.

horizontalSpacing.description: The fill's spacing factor in the X direction (Vector fills).

verticalSpacing.description: The fill's spacing factor in the Y direction (Vector fills).

angle.description: The angle of the fill in radians (Vector, Symbol, and gradient fills).

bitPattern.description: 16 hex characters (8 bytes) describing the fill's bitmap pattern, one line of the pattern per byte, matching the Pattern field of the Attribute Manager XML export.

percent.description: Translucency percentage [0..1] (gradient and some Solid fills).

texture.description: Used for Image and gradient fills. Only name, rotationAngle, xSize, ySize, mirrorX, and mirrorY are used for Fills.

lineItems.description: Vectorial fill line items (Vector fills only).

symbolLines.description: Line items of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolArcs.description: Arc items of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolHotspots.description: Hotspot coordinates of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

overwriteExisting.description: Overwrite the Fill if exists with the same name, or if index is given with the same index. The default is false.

folderPath.description: The path of the folder relative to the embedded library, for example 'Office/Doors'. Missing parent folders are created too; folders that already exist are kept.

graphicOverrideCombinations.description: The graphic override combinations to create.

name.description: The name of the combination, unique within the project.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The rules of the combination, in priority order.

graphicOverrideCombinationIds.description: The identifiers of the created combinations, or errors, in the order of the input.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules to create.

name.description: The name of the rule, unique within the project.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group to put the rule in. Created when it does not exist.

criterionXML.description: The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Take it from GetGraphicOverrideRules and change its values: Archicad drops XML written from scratch without an error, and the rule then applies to all elements. Left out together with 'criterion': Archicad's default criterion for new rules.

criterion.description: The criterion of the rule as structured conditions, turned into Archicad's criterion XML. Use it instead of criterionXML, not with it.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The identifiers of the created rules, or errors, in the order of the input.

name.description: Name of the override combination. When a combination with this name exists, its rule list is replaced.

ruleNames.description: Names of the override rules in the combination, in order. Rule names are unique in the project, whatever the rule group. An empty list makes a combination without rules.

combinationId.description: The created or changed override combination.

name.description: Name of the override rule. Rule names are unique in the project: an existing rule with this name is overwritten, in whichever rule group it is.

ruleGroupName.description: Rule group of a new rule, created when it does not exist. Default: 'Tapir'. An overwritten rule stays in its own group.

criterionXML.description: Optional criterion XML. Archicad only takes XML in its own format: read it from a rule made in the GUI with GetGraphicalOverrideRules and change the values. XML written from scratch is dropped without an error, and so is an empty one: the rule then applies to all elements.

surfaceRGB.description: Optional color override of the cut and uncut surfaces. Components are in the 0..1 range.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index override for lines, markers and texts. Only a positive index takes effect.

overrideContours.description: Optional. If true, the contours of the overridden surfaces are recolored too.

ruleId.description: The created or overwritten override rule.

begCoordinate.description: Start point of the grid line (the object's insertion point).

endCoordinate.description: End point of the grid line. Sets the direction and, unless lengthMode is 'none', the length.

lengthMode.description: How the line length is applied. length (default): to the GDL parameter AC_Length when the library part has it, as the Grid Tool's grid marker does; otherwise to the object's A size, converted to xRatio as CreateObjects does. none: the length is left to 'parameters'.

floorIndex.description: Home story index. Default: the tool default.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index. Only a positive index takes effect. Default: the tool default.

parameters.description: GDL parameters to set by name (read the names with GetGridElementDefaults). The value is a number, a boolean or a string. Unknown names and wrong value types are reported in warnings and skipped. The tool defaults can look different from a grid drawn with the Grid Tool (for example a short line with a leader to the bubble); to get the same look, copy the parameters of such a grid (GetGridElements with includeParameters).

value.description: A number or a boolean for a numeric parameter, a string for a String or Title parameter.

warnings.description: Parameters that were not set, prefixed with the index of the grid element.

elementGroups.description: A list of element groups to create.

groupGuids.description: The results of the group creation operations.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the hatch on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the hatch outline (single contour, no holes). Do not repeat the first point at the end.

arcs.description: The arcs of the hatch outline.

contourPenIndex.description: Optional pen index for the contour. By default the current pen is used.

fillPenIndex.description: Optional pen index for the fill. By default the current pen is used.

foregroundColor.description: Optional RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given. The same format as the colors returned by GetZoneCategories and GetPenTables.

backgroundColor.description: Optional RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.

fillId.description: Optional fill attribute. By default the current fill is used.

roomSpecial.description: Special area percent in a room (negative means OFF).

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink module nodes to create. A node that already points at the same source file (compared case-insensitively) is returned as it is, with existing: true, and the name and story settings asked for are ignored. On Archicad 25 a node that has not been placed yet cannot be found, so a repeated request there creates a second node.

sourceLocation.description: Absolute path of the module source file (.mod or .pln).

name.description: Optional display name of the node. Defaults to the file name. Ignored when a node for the same file already exists.

storyRangeType.description: Optional. Which stories of the source are placed: all of them, or the single reference story. Ignored when a node for the same file already exists.

refFloorIndex.description: Optional index of the reference story in the source file. Defaults to 0. Ignored when a node for the same file already exists.

hotlinkNodes.description: One item per requested node, in order: the node guid with its existing flag, or an error.

hotspotsData.description: Array of data to create Hotspots.

items.description: The parameters of the new Hotspot.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the hotspot on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

penIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

interiorElevationsData.description: Array of data to create Interior Elevation elements.

name.description: The name of the issue.

tagText.description: Tag text of the issue, optional.

foldersData.description: Array of data to create keynote folders.

parentFolderId.description: The parent folder. Optional; defaults to the root folder.

parentElementId.description: The parent element if the label is an associative label.

labelClass.description: Optional; if omitted, inherits the current Label tool default (which may silently resolve to either class - explicitly setting this avoids ambiguity). 'Symbol' needs a symbol library part, which only the Label tool default or the favorite given in favoriteName can provide: when those are a Text label, the item fails instead of placing a label without content.

text.description: The text content if the label is a text label. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF. Ignored if 'runs' is also given.

runs.description: Multi-style text content for a text label: an array of styled runs, concatenated in order. Takes precedence over 'text' if both are given.

begCoordinate.description: The begin coordinate of leader line. Optional parameter, but either begCoordinate or parentElementId must be provided. Unless midCoordinate and endCoordinate are both given too, the label is created at its default position relative to the parent element (Archicad's 'createAtDefaultPosition'), so the label may not end up at begCoordinate - read it back with GetDetailsOfElements after creation.

midCoordinate.description: The mid coordinate of leader line. Optional parameter; give it together with endCoordinate to place the label exactly where the coordinates say.

endCoordinate.description: The end coordinate of leader line. Optional parameter; give it together with midCoordinate to place the label exactly where the coordinates say.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor or the floor of the parent element is used.

lampsData.description: Array of data to create Lamps.

items.description: The parameters of the new Lamp.

libraryPartName.description: The name of the lamp library part to use.

fixPoint.description: 0-based index of the hotspot to keep fixed (raw API_ObjectType.fixPoint value, not 1-based).

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default hotspot offset regardless of what is sent) - same class of read-only-in-practice field as Morph's bodyType/edgeType/level.

useFixedAngle.description: Use a fixed rotation angle. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify.

lightColor.description: Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default light color). lightIsOn (the on/off state, as opposed to the color) does not have this problem.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from the coordinate's z value.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

layerCombinationDataArray.description: Array of data to create new Layer Combinations.

items.description: Data to create a Layer Combination.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Layer Combination to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Layer Combination to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Layer Combination with the given name will be overwritten.

index.description: Index of the existing Layer to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Layer with the given name will be overwritten.

intersectionGroupNr.description: Intersection group. Elements on layers having the same group will be intersected.

overwriteExisting.description: Overwrite the Layer if exists with the same name, or if index is given with the same index. The default is false.

previousNavigatorItemId.description: The sibling after which the new layout is placed, as in MoveNavigatorItem. It must be a child of parentNavigatorItemId (or of the Layout Book root when that is omitted). Cannot be combined with position.

position.description: Where to place the new layout under its parent. Archicad inserts new layouts at the first place, which renumbers the sheets after them; "last" appends it after the existing children instead. Cannot be combined with previousNavigatorItemId.

paperWidth.description: Optional paper width in mm, used together with paperHeight. Sets the size of the new layout, and of the master layout when this command creates it from masterLayoutName: a new master starts with the template's default size, which layoutParameters cannot change. An existing master keeps its size. Wins over layoutParameters.horizontalSize.

paperHeight.description: Optional paper height in mm, used together with paperWidth. See paperWidth. Wins over layoutParameters.verticalSize.

levelDimensionsData.description: Array of data to create Level Dimensions (the Level Dimension tool of the floor plan).

items.description: The parameters of the new Level Dimension.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a Level Dimension favorite to base the new element on. Its settings (marker, format, text style, layer, pen) are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

position.description: The location of the marker on the floor plan. With a parentElementId it must lie on that element, the measured level is the parent's height at this point. Outside the parent's outline Archicad still creates the dimension, but without a height (GetDetailsOfElements reads a level of -110000000).

parentElementId.description: Optional element the level dimension is associated with (Mesh, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Beam, Column, Wall, Object, Stair ...). The dimension then shows the element's height at the position and follows the element when it changes. Without it the dimension measures the floor level, or the given static level.

level.description: Optional fixed level value in meters (absolute, from the project zero). Only used without parentElementId; the dimension then shows this value instead of the floor level.

floorIndex.description: The index of the floor to place the dimension on. Optional parameter, by default the floor of the parent element, otherwise the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the dimension on. Optional parameter, by default the layer of the favorite or the Level Dimension tool default is used.

pen.description: Pen index of the marker. Optional parameter.

textHeight.description: Height of the dimension text in millimeters (paper size). Optional parameter.

textPen.description: Pen index of the dimension text. Optional parameter.

dimForm.description: Marker type of the Level Dimension tool, 0-19 as Archicad stores it (read it back with GetDetailsOfElements from an existing level dimension or one placed with a favorite). Optional parameter.

needPlus.description: Show a plus sign for positive values. Optional parameter.

markerSize.description: Size of the marker in millimeters (paper size). Optional parameter.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the marker in radians. Optional parameter.

origin.description: The origin the level is measured from. Optional parameter.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the line on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line? Optional, defaults to false.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

lineTypeId.description: Optional line type attribute. By default the current line type is used.

scaleWithPlan.description: If true, the line type parameters are defined in meters at the given defineScale and scale on printout with the actual plan scale. If false (default), the parameters are fixed values in millimeters as the line will appear on the printout.

defineScale.description: The floor plan scale the line type is defined with. Only used if scaleWithPlan is true.

lineType.description: Solid, Dashed, or Symbol. Defaults to Solid.

period.description: The length of one period (Dashed and Symbol line types).

height.description: The height of the symbol line (Symbol line type only).

dashItems.description: Dash-gap pairs describing one period (Dashed line type only).

lineItems.description: Symbol items describing one period (Symbol line type only).

domain.description: Required for all types except Equipment.

orientationRotation.description: Optional rotation vector of the orientation. Defaults to (0, 1, 0).

systemGroupId.description: The system group the new physical system belongs to.

rootElementId.description: The MEP element the system starts from. Archicad keeps it only while it is part of an MEP network: the root of a stand-alone element is cleared when the MEP networks are recalculated.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the physical system.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the route polyline.

insulationMaterialId.description: Identifier of the surface (material) attribute applied to the insulation of the elements of the system.

items.description: Data to create or modify a Profile. Its geometry (the cross-section shape) comes from sourceAttributeId (an existing Profile's geometry, copied), from newSkins (AC27+ only, caller-supplied polygon geometry), or both combined. When creating a brand-new Profile (overwriteExisting false, or true but no existing match), at least one of the two must be given. When overwriteExisting targets an existing Profile, both are optional - the existing Profile's own current geometry is preserved by default (e.g. to change only wallType, or to add newSkins on top of the unchanged existing shape). skinOverrides and newSkins' edgeOverrides target skins/edges by the identifiers/indices GetProfiles reports.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Profile to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

sourceAttributeId.description: Identifier of an existing Profile whose geometry (cross-section shape) will be copied as the starting point. Optional if newSkins is given: omit it to build the Profile's geometry entirely from newSkins instead of copying anything (AC27+ only).

wallType.description: Profile available for walls. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

otherGDLObjectType.description: Profile available for other GDL based objects. Defaults to the source Profile's value.

skinOverrides.description: Modifications to apply to specific skins of the copied geometry, e.g. to change a skin's building material without rebuilding the profile's shape. Each skinId comes from a prior GetProfiles call's skins[].skinId on the source Profile (or, when overwriteExisting is true, on the Profile being overwritten).

skinId.description: Identifies which skin to modify, from GetProfiles' skins[].skinId.

edgeOverrides.description: Modifications to specific edges of this skin, targeted by their position (0-based) in GetProfiles' skins[].edges.

newSkins.description: AC27+ only. Adds brand-new skins built from caller-supplied polygon geometry, instead of (or in addition to) whatever was copied from sourceAttributeId. Combine with sourceAttributeId to add skins to a copied Profile, or omit sourceAttributeId to build a Profile's geometry entirely from newSkins.

replaceSkins.description: AC27+ only. When overwriteExisting targets an existing Profile, discard every one of its existing skins (and any sourceAttributeId geometry given alongside it) before applying newSkins, instead of adding newSkins on top of the preserved existing geometry. Use this to fully replace a Profile's cross-section with a caller-authored shape while keeping its guid and scalar fields (wallType etc.) - e.g. to sync a Profile's geometry from another project, where sourceAttributeId can't be used because it only resolves within the same file. Also discards any existing profileModifiers, since those are tied to the specific geometry being replaced. Ignored when creating a brand-new Profile (there is nothing to discard yet).

overwriteExisting.description: Overwrite the Profile if exists with the same name, or if index is given with the same index. The default is false.

issues.description: Leave it empty to export all issues.

model3D.description: The 3D model type: Block, Wireframe, Hidden Line or Shading, as the integer value of API_3DModelTypeID.

monochromeEnabled.description: The model is shown in monochrome colors.

monochromeSurfaceColor.description: The surface color of the monochrome model.

monochromeContourColor.description: The contour color of the monochrome model.

backgroundAsInRendering.description: The background is the same as in the rendering settings.

chainBackgroundColors.description: The sky and the ground background colors are chained.

backgroundSkyColor.description: The sky color of the background (API_3DStyle.bkgSkyColor).

shadingContours.description: The contours in shaded mode, as the integer value of API_ShadingContoursID.

vectorialSunShadow.description: The vectorial sun shadow options, as the integer value of API_VectorShadowID.

version.description: Version number in the form of "1.1.1".

elementType.description: Only the Favorites of this element type are returned. Omit it to get every Favorite.

propertyGroups.description: Every property group, including empty ones.

modelCheckTypeId.description: The type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check.

archicadLocation.description: The location of the Archicad executable in the filesystem.

mainVersion.description: The main version of the running Archicad, e.g. 29.

releaseVersion.description: The release (update) version of the running Archicad.

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

caption.description: The caption of the Archicad application window. Missing when Archicad does not report it.

projectFilePath.description: The absolute path of the project or template file (for example .pln or .tpl) to read the attributes from.

attributesByType.description: One item per requested attribute type, in the order of attributeTypes.

name.description: The autotext's name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

key.description: The autotext's key. To embed it in the content of a Text or Label element, surround it with '<' and '>', e.g. '<PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548>'.

keys.description: Autotext keys as returned by GetAutoTextKeys or GetProjectInfoFields (without the surrounding '<' and '>'), e.g. 'PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548' or 'PROJECTNAME'.

filterByTypeId.description: Optional. Filter by libpart type (matches the value returned by LibPartTypeIdToString).

skippedCount.description: Library parts that ACAPI_LibraryPart_Get failed to read. Non-zero means the inventory is partial.

skippedSample.description: First five failed indices with their ACAPI error code, for diagnostic.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Building Material. If omitted, every field is returned.

buildingMaterials.description: A list of building materials or errors.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category the element has.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only.

elementClassifications.description: Order of the ids are the same as in the input. Non-existing elements or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

volumeTolerance.description: Intersection body volume greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

performSurfaceCheck.description: Enables surface collision check. If disabled the surfaceTolerance value will be ignored. By default it's false.

surfaceTolerance.description: Intersection body surface area greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Composite. If omitted, every field is returned.

composites.description: A list of composites or errors.

elements.description: The owner (host) elements whose connected elements are collected, e.g. Walls, Curtain Walls, Stairs or Railings.

connectedElementType.description: The type of the connected elements to collect, e.g. Window or Door for a Wall owner, or a subelement type of a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing owner.

databases.description: The database of each element, in the order of the input elements. Pass windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it.

name.description: The name of the database (for example the name of the layout). Empty for databases without a name, like the floor plan.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view.

layerCombinationId.description: The layer combination in effect in the current window. Missing when the current state of the layers matches no layer combination.

name.description: The name of the layer combination. Missing together with layerCombinationId.

index.description: The attribute index of the current Pen Table, as returned by Archicad.

isPenTableAttribute.description: True if the index refers to an existing Pen Table attribute. When false, attributeId and name are omitted; the pens in effect can not be read with GetPenTables.

name.description: The name of the current Pen Table attribute.

penCount.description: The number of pens in the current Pen Table. Omitted when it can not be read.

source.description: Optional, 3DWindow by default. The window whose image is returned: the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window.

format.description: Optional, png by default. The image format.

image.description: The base64 encoded image, in the requested format.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

scale.description: The denominator of the drawing scale of the current window: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Always 1.0 for layouts.

types.description: The types of the databases to list. Optional, by default the databases of every type are listed.

name.description: The name of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

referenceId.description: The reference id of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

designOptionSetId.description: The guid identifier of the design option set.

name.description: The name of the design option set.

designOptions.description: The list of design options in the set.

teamworkId.description: The Teamwork identifier of the project's design options. Present only in Teamwork projects.

fields.description: Optional filter for the fields to return for each element. When omitted, every field is returned. Fields not listed are not computed at all, so listing only what you need skips in particular the floorPlanPolygons extraction, which regenerates each element's 2D drawing primitives and can dominate the execution time of batch reads.

detailsOfElements.description: One entry per input element, in the same order as the input elements array. An element that cannot be read gets an error entry in its place, so the position of an entry tells which input element it belongs to.

oneOf.description: Details of an element. When the optional fields filter is given in the input, only the requested fields are present; the required list below applies to unfiltered requests.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink; such elements are read-only.

floorPlanPolygons.description: Cut-fill polygons as drawn on the floor plan (wall joins resolved by ArchiCAD). Only collected for construction element types whose floor plan symbol comes from a real cut through the element - walls, columns, beams and their segments, slabs, roofs, shells, meshes, morphs, curtain walls and their segments/panels/frames, stairs and their risers/treads/structures. Absent for every other type, when the element has no cut fill, or when the floor plan database is not accessible.

elements.description: The identifier of the dimension elements.

contentBoxes.description: One item per input element, in the same order: the full content box of the Drawing, or an error.

contentBox.description: The full boundary box of the Drawing's content, independent of its frame, as returned by Archicad.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical circuits.

electricalPanels.description: Optional list of electrical panels whose circuits are returned. When neither elements nor electricalPanels is given, every circuit of every electrical panel of the project is returned.

electricalCircuits.description: The given circuits first, in their order, then the circuits of the given panels, in the order of the panels.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical devices. Every electrical device of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalDevices.description: The electrical devices, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical panels. Every electrical panel of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalPanels.description: The electrical panels, in the order of the given elements.

voltage.description: The default voltage of the project.

crossSectionalArea.description: The cross-sectional area of the wire in square millimeters.

elementType.description: The type of the element to look for. Only polygonal element types can be searched, for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch.

coordinate.description: The point to search at, in the project's coordinates, on the floor plan of the current database.

z.description: Optional. The elevation of the search point, handed to Archicad together with the coordinate. Default is 0.

filters.description: Optional. Only an element passing every given filter is found (the same values as FilterElements accepts).

found.description: True when an element of the given type was found at the coordinate.

elementId.description: The identifier of the found element. Absent when nothing was found.

categories.description: The element categories of the project, each with its possible values.

name.description: The localized name of the category, for display only.

values.description: The possible values of the category.

isVisibleOnUI.description: The value is offered in the settings dialogs of Archicad.

usableAsCriteria.description: The value can be used as a criterion, for example in Find & Select and in Graphic Override rules.

elementId.description: The clicked element. In a section or elevation window it is the model element the section element was cut from.

elementType.description: The type of the clicked element (one of the ElementType values, or Unknown).

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates, as GetPointFromUser returns it.

elementPosition.description: The coordinate of the clicked part of the element (e.g. its node or hotspot), when Archicad gives one for it.

cancelled.description: True when the input was cancelled with Escape; no other field is returned then.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

elementSetsOfElements.description: The element sets that contain each given element, or an error, in the order of the input. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined.

elementSets.description: The element sets that contain the element. Empty if the element is not part of any element set.

elementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

elementTrims.description: One item per queried element, in order. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not trimmed.

names.description: The localized name of each element type, aligned with the input, or an error.

groups.description: The groups to get the elements of.

elementsOfGroups.description: The elements directly contained by each given group, or an error.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

favoriteSettings.description: The settings of each given Favorite, in the order of the input, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

folder.description: The folder hierarchy of the Favorite in the Favorites palette. Empty for the root.

libPart.description: The library part of the Favorite, for the library part based types (Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone). Absent otherwise or when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters stored with the Favorite. Empty for the types without GDL parameters.

marker.description: The marker stored with a Window or Door Favorite. Absent when the Favorite has no marker - that is not an error.

libPart.description: The library part of the marker. Absent when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the marker.

subElements.description: The sub-elements stored with the Favorite.

subType.description: MainMarker for the main marker of the element; Other for any other kind of sub-element.

libPart.description: The library part of the sub-element. Absent when it has none or it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the sub-element.

fills.description: A list of fills or errors.

fontNames.description: Names of the fonts to find, as the Text tool's font list shows them and GetDetailsOfElements reports them in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'.

fonts.description: One item per name, in the order given: the font found, or an error when no loaded font has the name.

fontIndex.description: Index of the font (from 1), as Text and Label fields reference it in fontIndex.

fontName.description: Name of the font as Archicad carries it.

graphicOverrideCombinations.description: The graphic override combinations of the project.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The rules of the combination, in priority order.

graphicOverrideRuleGroups.description: The graphic override rule groups of the project, empty ones included.

GraphicOverrideCriterion.description: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property. 'and'/'or' combine a flat list of other conditions (no nesting, see their description). 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: the renovation status of an element, and the shape, limits and orientation of an Opening.

and.description: Matches if all of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.

or.description: Matches if any of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.
