holes.description: The 3D holes of the mesh. Replaces all existing holes; an empty array removes them. When given without polygonCoordinates, the existing outline is kept.

sublines.description: The leveling sublines inside the polygon of the mesh. Replaces existing sublines entirely.

MeshRidges.description: How ridges between mesh facets are displayed in 3D: 'AllSharp' shows all ridges, 'AllSmooth' hides them, 'UserDefined' shows only ridges along user-defined level lines (the drawing-set look for contour-line topography).

MeshSkirtType.description: The type of the skirt structure.

coordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the leveling subline of the mesh.

mirrorAxis.description: The mirror axis: the line through two points on the floor plan.

beginPoint.description: First point of the mirror axis.

endPoint.description: Second point of the mirror axis. Must differ from beginPoint.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, a mirrored copy of the element is created and the original is kept. By default it's false.

width.description: Cross section width of the beam. Applied to all segments.

height.description: Cross section height of the beam. Applied to all segments.

isWidthAndHeightLinked.description: When true, Archicad keeps width and height equal and setting one changes the other - set to false first to give width/height independent values. Applied to all segments.

circleBased.description: True for a round beam cross section, false for rectangular. Ignored once profileId switches the beam to a custom profile shape. Applied to all segments.

buildingMaterialId.description: Cross section building material (round or rectangular, per circleBased). Applied to all segments.

profileId.description: Switches the cross section to this custom extruded profile (circleBased becomes false). Applied to all segments.

holes.description: Replaces all holes currently placed on the beam.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute Z of the column's bottom. The home story is derived from it unless floorIndex is given; a Z below the lowest story stays on the lowest story with a negative bottomOffset.

floorIndex.description: Optional home story index (as returned by GetStories). With zCoordinate it pins the story the Z is resolved against; alone it only changes the home story (combine with bottomOffset to set the offset relative to it).

height.description: Sets relativeTopStory to 0 (explicit height). Do not combine with relativeTopStory in the same call - see the note on relativeTopStory below.

isFlipped.description: Has no visible effect on a circular column (circleBased cross section) - Archicad ignores it there.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the column's top to another story instead of an explicit height - do not set together with 'height' in the same call, see the note on 'height' above.

width.description: Cross section width of the column. Applied to all segments.

depth.description: Cross section depth (height) of the column. Applied to all segments.

isWidthAndHeightLinked.description: When true, Archicad keeps width and depth equal and setting one changes the other - set to false first to give width/depth independent values. Applied to all segments.

circleBased.description: True for a round column cross section, false for rectangular. Ignored once profileId switches the column to a custom profile shape. Applied to all segments.

buildingMaterialId.description: Cross section building material (round or rectangular, per circleBased). Applied to all segments.

profileId.description: Switches the cross section to this custom extruded profile (circleBased becomes false). Applied to all segments.

reveal.description: Turn the reveal on or off.

revealDepthOffset.description: Distance the frame plane is moved across the wall thickness, along the wall normal.

electricalCircuitsData.description: Array of data to modify electrical circuits. Only the given fields are changed.

wiringTypeName.description: One of the wiring types of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

electricalDevicesData.description: Array of data to modify electrical devices. Only the given fields are changed.

loadClassificationName.description: One of the load classifications of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

electricalPanelsData.description: Array of data to modify electrical panels. Only the given fields are changed.

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

wiringTypesToRemove.description: The names of the wiring types to remove.

loadClassificationsToRemove.description: The names of the load classifications to remove.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules to modify.

name.description: The new name of the rule.

criterionXML.description: The new criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Take it from GetGraphicOverrideRules and change its values: Archicad drops XML written from scratch without an error, and the rule then applies to all elements.

criterion.description: The new criterion of the rule as structured conditions, turned into Archicad's criterion XML. Use it instead of criterionXML, not with it.

foldersData.description: Array of data to modify keynote folders. Only provided fields are changed.

itemsData.description: Array of data to modify keynote items. Only provided fields are changed.

labelsWithDetails.description: Array of Label elements to modify, with the fields to change. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left as-is. The label's class (Text/Symbol) cannot be changed after creation. A change of the text, the runs, or a run-level style field (pen, font, faces, height, effects) rebuilds the content as one paragraph, which makes the label's text auto-width (word wrap off), as SetDetailsOfElements does, and on a multi-run label applies that style to every run; the other style fields leave the content as it is.

text.description: The new text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.

lampsWithDetails.description: Array of elements to modify, with the fields to change. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left as-is.

fixPoint.description: 0-based index of the hotspot to keep fixed (raw API_ObjectType.fixPoint value, not 1-based).

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default hotspot offset regardless of what is sent) - same class of read-only-in-practice field as Morph's bodyType/edgeType/level.

useFixedAngle.description: Use a fixed rotation angle. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify.

lightColor.description: Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default light color). lightIsOn (the on/off state, as opposed to the color) does not have this problem.

physicalSystemsData.description: Array of data to modify physical systems. Only the given fields are changed.

name.description: The new name of the physical system.

rootElementId.description: The MEP element the system starts from. Archicad keeps it only while it is part of an MEP network: the root of a stand-alone element is cleared when the MEP networks are recalculated.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the physical system.

routingElementsData.description: Array of data to modify MEP routing elements. Only provided fields are changed.

crossSectionWidth.description: New cross section width applied to all segments.

crossSectionHeight.description: New cross section height applied to all segments.

crossSectionShape.description: The new shape is applied to all segments.

crossSectionReferenceId.description: New cross section reference id of the segment preference table applied to all segments (used for circular cross sections). Resolved against preferenceTableId if given, otherwise against the table the segments already use.

preferenceTableId.description: New segment preference table (guid as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables) applied to all segments. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

branchPreferenceTableId.description: New branch preference table (guid as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables) of the routing element.

anchor.description: New anchor point of the cross section, on a 3x3 grid, applied to all segments.

referenceLineOffsetX.description: New horizontal offset of the reference line from the anchor point, applied to all segments.

referenceLineOffsetY.description: New vertical offset of the reference line from the anchor point, applied to all segments.

wallThickness.description: New wall thickness applied to all segments.

flangeSize.description: New flange size applied to all segments.

nodePositions.description: New positions of the routing nodes. The size must match the number of nodes of the route.

systemGroupsData.description: Array of data to modify system groups.

name.description: The new name of the system group.

rotationDegreesZ.description: Turns the Morph about the vertical axis through its origin, counterclockwise seen from above, in degrees. Added to the current rotation.

body.description: When given, discards the Morph's ENTIRE existing geometry and rebuilds it from this (mirrors CreateProfiles' replaceSkins) - not a partial edit.

xAxis.description: Replaces the rotation part of the placement transform outright. Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together. If rotationDegreesZ is also given in the same call, it is applied first and this then overwrites its result.

objectsWithDetails.description: Array of elements to modify, with the fields to change. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left as-is.

fixPoint.description: 0-based index of the hotspot to keep fixed (raw API_ObjectType.fixPoint value, not 1-based).

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (Get always reports the library part's own default hotspot offset regardless of what is sent) - same class of read-only-in-practice field as Morph's bodyType/edgeType/level.

useFixedAngle.description: Use a fixed rotation angle. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify.

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) roof - a Composite roof takes its thickness from the composite attribute. Send structureType 'Basic' in the same call to switch a composite roof first.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute Z of the slab's reference level. The home story is derived from it unless floorIndex is given; a Z below the lowest story stays on the lowest story with a negative level.

floorIndex.description: Optional home story index (as returned by GetStories). With zCoordinate it pins the story the Z is resolved against; alone it only changes the home story.

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) slab - a Composite slab takes its thickness from the composite attribute. Send structureType 'Basic' in the same call to switch a composite slab first.

polygonOutline.description: Replaces the slab's entire polygon, including its holes - resend the holes field too to keep them, otherwise they are removed.

holes.description: Can be given on its own, without polygonOutline, to add/remove/clear holes in place (an empty array clears all holes) - the slab's current outline is reused unchanged.

textsWithDetails.description: Array of Text elements to modify, with the fields to change. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left as-is. A change of the text, the runs, or a run-level style field (pen, font, faces, height, effects) rebuilds the content as one paragraph, which makes the element auto-width (word wrap off), as SetDetailsOfElements does, and on a multi-run text applies that style to every run; the other style fields leave the content as it is.

coordinate.description: The new placement position. As in CreateTexts, the z value selects the floor when floorIndex is omitted.

floorIndex.description: Optional. Moves the text to this floor; when omitted and a coordinate is given, the floor is derived from its z value.

text.description: The new text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.

geometryType.description: Polygonal is not settable here; it is read-only via GetDetailsOfElements. This is unrelated to slantAlpha/slantBeta - see profileType for the cross section shape those depend on.

arcAngle.description: Arc angle in radians; non-zero makes the wall curved (begCoordinate/endCoordinate are the chord endpoints).

height.description: Sets relativeTopStory to 0 (explicit height). Do not combine with relativeTopStory in the same call - whichever is applied last wins, and Archicad recomputes the actual height from the story elevations once relativeTopStory is non-zero.

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) wall - a Composite or Profile wall takes its thickness from the composite or profile attribute. Send structureType 'Basic' in the same call to switch such a wall first.

profileType.description: slantAlpha/slantBeta only have an effect once this is set to Slanted.

slantAlpha.description: Only has an effect once profileType is set to Slanted or Trapez.

slantBeta.description: Only has an effect once profileType is set to Slanted or Trapez.

topOffset.description: Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the wall's top to another story instead of an explicit height - do not set together with 'height' in the same call, see the note on 'height' above.

visibility.description: Confirmed live on Archicad 29 (#852): a wall there knows only 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories' (Wall Settings offers no Custom option), and Archicad silently drops every other combination written here although the command reports success - showAllAbove, showAllBelow, showRelAbove and showRelBelow (any value, 0 included) and showOnHome true -> false all read back unchanged. 'All relevant stories' is isAutoOnStoryVisibility true. 'Home story only' takes two calls: first isAutoOnStoryVisibility true (Archicad resets the custom fields to 0), then isAutoOnStoryVisibility false with visibility { showOnHome: true }. Archicad 30 adds a Custom option for walls; whether the other fields become writable there is untested.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true (the default on a new wall), Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the wall's vertical extent and ignores any value set for it. Setting 'visibility' without also setting this field turns it off automatically. See the note on 'visibility' for which combinations a wall accepts.

contourPen.description: Pen of the wall's own contour/reference outline (API_WallType::contPen) - distinct from cutFillPen, which is the cut fill pattern's pen. Not inheritable/overridable like cutFillPen, it is the wall's own pen index directly, the same field regardless of structureType.

contourPen3D.description: Pen of the wall's contour in 3D views (API_WallType::contPen3D).

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the wall's own contour (API_WallType::contLtype) - pairs with contourPen, which only sets the pen, not the line type.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "OutLines Only" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup (API_WallType::belowViewLineType).

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

viewDepthLimitation.description: Only has an effect on a multi-story wall (relativeTopStory/topOffset making it span more than one story).

useCompositePriority.description: When true, the Composite's own priority is used at junctions instead of connectionPriority.

inheritEndSurface.description: The end surface of the wall is inherited from the adjoining wall.

alignTexture.description: Align texture mapping to the wall's edges.

polyCanChange.description: The polygonal wall's corners can be changed in case of L and T connections. Only meaningful for a Polygonal wall (geometryType).

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

logHeight.description: Height of the log for log walls. 0 means a normal (non-log) wall.

reveal.description: Turn the reveal on or off.

revealDepthOffset.description: Distance the frame plane is moved across the wall thickness, along the wall normal.

MorphBody.description: A Morph's full body geometry: an indexed vertex list plus one entry per face (polygon). Shared shape between GetDetailsOfElements' output and CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs' input - what Get reports is what Create/Modify accept back. There is no fillet/chamfer operation in the Archicad API - a caller wanting rounded geometry must supply the already-tessellated facets here; edgeOverrides only controls how an existing straight edge is DISPLAYED (hidden/visible/smooth-shaded), not its shape.

bodyType.description: Whether the body is a closed solid or an open surface shell. Reported accurately on Get; on Create/Modify this is set on the element but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect (bodyType has been observed always coming back Solid regardless of what was requested - see edgeOverrides' note).

isClosed.description: READ-ONLY, Get output only (ignored if sent to Create/Modify). Geometrically computed (Modeler::MeshBody::IsClosedBody): true if every edge in the body has exactly two adjacent faces (a watertight/manifold volume), false if any edge borders only one face (an open shell / has holes or gaps). Distinct from bodyType, which is the caller's declared INTENT (Solid vs Surface) rather than the actual computed geometry - a body can be declared bodyType 'Solid' yet still be geometrically open if a face is missing.

edgeDefault.description: Default display status for every edge that has no entry in edgeOverrides. Reported accurately on Get. On Create/Modify it takes effect from Archicad 29 on, where it is applied to every edge of the element with ACAPI_Element_ChangeMorphEdgeType right after the element is created or changed (e.g. 'HardHidden' hides all edges of a triangulated body). On Archicad 28 and earlier it is set on the element but does not take effect due to the same confirmed Archicad SDK bug as edgeOverrides (element.morph.edgeType is silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change).

vertices.description: Flat, indexed vertex list, local to the Morph's own placement (not world coordinates). A Solid body needs at least 4 (a tetrahedron, the minimum closed volume); a Surface body has no closedness requirement at all - the minimum is 2 vertices joined by a single wireEdge (a lone vertex with no edge at all is rejected by Archicad itself, confirmed live) - enforced with a bodyType-aware error message, not by this minItems floor alone.

polygons.description: One entry per face loop (into `vertices`), counterclockwise as seen from outside the body. Optional - a body made entirely of wireEdges (see below) needs none. Set "filled": false on an entry to create only that loop's edges (e.g. the outline of a pyramid's side faces) without an actual filled face.

wireEdges.description: Standalone edges that belong to no face at all (e.g. a bare rectangle outline, or a pyramid with a filled base but wireframe-only sides - set "filled": false on a polygons entry for a whole closed loop like that instead, this is for individual edges not already covered by any polygon loop). Reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (every edge with zero adjacent faces); accepted back by CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects - reuses whatever edge already exists between those two vertices if the polygons above happen to share it.

edgeOverrides.description: READ-ONLY in practice: reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (reflecting whatever Archicad itself currently has), but CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs silently ignore this field on input - per-edge display status cannot be set by an add-on due to a confirmed, still-unresolved Archicad SDK bug (element.morph.edgeType/bodyType are silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change; see the GRAPHISOFT community forum thread 'Help with setting morph's hidden edges in the API'). To hide or smooth ALL edges of a Morph use edgeDefault, which does take effect from Archicad 29 on. Sparse when present - only edges whose display status differs from edgeDefault get an entry. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects.

smooth.description: Shade the two adjacent faces smoothly across this edge instead of as a hard crease - the 'aide a la courbe' rounded-look hint. Does not change actual geometry.

silhouetteOnly.description: Show this edge's line only where it forms a silhouette/contour from the current viewpoint.

origin.description: Translation component of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's origin column).

xAxis.description: X axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's first column). Omit on Create to get an identity rotation; give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

yAxis.description: Y axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's second column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

zAxis.description: Z axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's third column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

buildingMaterialId.description: The Morph's building material - a single, whole-volume property (what the mass is 'made of', governing cut-fill/quantity takeoff), NOT settable per face. Per-face appearance is controlled separately by each polygon's own surfaceId (see MorphBody) - confirmed live these are two independent, unrelated attributes (a Morph can have one uniform building material while showing a different Surface finish on each face).

surfaceId.description: The Morph's own default Surface (element.morph.material) - used for any face that has no per-face surfaceId override of its own (see MorphBody polygons[].surfaceId). Distinct from buildingMaterialId (the whole-volume material). Confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this specific field when set through ACAPI_Element_Create alone (reproduced identically on Archicad 27 and 29 - not a version-specific issue, unlike polygons[].surfaceId below); CreateMorphs works around this transparently with an internal follow-up Change right after Create, so this field behaves correctly end-to-end despite the underlying quirk.

castShadow.description: Whether the body casts shadow in 3D.

receiveShadow.description: Whether the body receives shadow in 3D.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, the per-story visibility (showContour/showFill) is calculated automatically from the Morph's vertical extent instead of using the explicit values.

showContour.description: Which stories display this Morph's contour. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Create/Modify do not reliably apply it (showAllBelow/showRelAbove/showRelBelow silently come back reset even when explicitly set and isAutoOnStoryVisibility is false) - the same class of confirmed Archicad SDK write bug as bodyType/edgeType/level (see MorphBody's notes). Set on the element regardless since doing so is harmless and forward-compatible.

showFill.description: Which stories display this Morph's floor plan fill. Same write-reliability caveat as showContour.

cutFillPen.description: Overridden cut fill foreground pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Overridden cut fill background pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutLineType.description: Line type of the cut contour.

overheadLineType.description: Line type of the overhead part (floor plan only).

overheadLinePen.description: Pen of the overhead part (floor plan only).

useCoverFillType.description: Use a dedicated floor plan fill instead of the one from the building material.

coverFillType.description: Floor plan fill type (only used when useCoverFillType is true).

use3DHatching.description: Derive the floor plan fill from the 3D material instead of coverFillType.

useDistortedCoverFill.description: Show the floor plan hatching as if projected onto a plane.

textureProjectionCoords.description: Texture projection coordinate system: origin, then 3 axis endpoints.

level.description: Z position of the free shape relative to the floor level. Reported accurately on Get, but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect on Create/Modify (same class of bug as bodyType/edgeType - see MorphBody's notes).

vertexIds.description: Counterclockwise outer-loop vertex indices for this face.

filled.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to create only this loop's edges (a wireframe outline, e.g. a bare rectangle with no surface fill) without an actual face - holes/surfaceId are ignored in that case, since there is no fill for them to apply to.

holes.description: Optional hole loops cut out of this face, each a clockwise list of vertex indices.

surfaceId.description: Optional per-face surface (render material) override. Uses the Morph's default surface when omitted. Ignored during creation in Archicad 25.

MorphQuantities.description: Quantities of a Morph element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

surface.description: Net area of the body surface.

floorPlanArea.description: Net area of the floor plan projection.

floorPlanPerimeter.description: Perimeter of the floor plan projection.

height.description: Height of the morph.

attributeIds.description: The attributes to move. They must have the attribute type of the target folder.

attributeFolders.description: The folders to move, with their contents. They must have the attribute type of the target folder.

targetFolder.description: The folder to move the attributes and folders into. An empty path is the root folder.

attributeExecutionResults.description: One result per item of attributeIds, in the same order.

folderExecutionResults.description: One result per item of attributeFolders, in the same order.

designOptionId.description: The identifier of the design option to move.

elementsWithMoveVectors.description: The elements with move vector pairs.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, then a copy of the element will be moved. By default it's false.

designOptionId.description: The identifier of the design option to move the element into. Use NULLGuid to remove the element from any design option and move it to the main model.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The rules to move, processed in this order.

ruleGroupName.description: The rule group the rule is moved to; it can be the rule's own group to change its place there. Created when no rule group has this name.

beforeGraphicOverrideRuleId.description: The rule of the target group the moved rule is put in front of. Left out: the rule becomes the last of the group.

NavigatorItem.description: A navigator item and the subtree below it.

name.description: The name of the navigator item.

prefix.description: The floor number for story items, an empty string for every other item type.

uiId.description: The identifier shown next to the name on the navigator.

customUiId.description: True when the identifier was typed by hand instead of being inherited from the Project Map source - the View Settings ID "Custom" radio button.

customName.description: True when the name was typed by hand instead of being inherited from the Project Map source - the View Settings name "Custom" radio button.

isIndependent.description: True when the item is independent, that is when its link to the Project Map is broken.

sourceNavigatorItemId.description: The identifier of the navigator item this one was created from: the Project Map item behind a view, or the source view behind a placed Drawing's Layout Book entry. Missing when the item has no such source; Project Map items never do.

childCount.description: The number of direct children Archicad reports for the item. Only present when GetNavigatorItemTree is called with includeChildCount true.

children.description: The children of the navigator item. Missing when the item has no children.

NavigatorItemId.description: The identifier of a navigator item.

NavigatorItemIdOrDatabaseIdAndWindowType.description: Identifies the window to change to. Either a navigatorItemId on its own (the navigator item's saved view settings are applied), or a windowType optionally narrowed to a specific databaseId, or a databaseId on its own (its window type is resolved automatically).

NavigatorItemIds.description: A list of navigator item identifiers.

NavigatorItemType.description: The type of the navigator item.

parentClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of the parent classification item. If not specified, the new classification item will be created as a child of the root.

nextClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of the next sibling classification item. If not specified, the new classification item will be created as the last child of its parent.

newAndReset.description: Optional. Also reset the working environment to the template's, as File > New > New and Reset All does, instead of keeping the current one as File > New does. Defaults to false.

NonLocalizedValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the nonlocalized value.

NormalAngleListPropertyValue.description: An angle list property value containing angles in an array. The values are measured in SI (radians).

NormalAnglePropertyValue.description: An angle property value containing a real angle. The value is measured in SI (radians).

NormalAreaListPropertyValue.description: An area list property value containing areas in an array. The values are measured in SI (square meters).

NormalAreaPropertyValue.description: An area property value containing a real area. The value is measured in SI (square meters).

NormalBooleanListPropertyValue.description: A boolean list property value containing boolean values in an array.

NormalBooleanPropertyValue.description: A boolean property value containing a valid boolean value.

NormalIntegerListPropertyValue.description: An integer list property value containing integers in an array.

NormalIntegerPropertyValue.description: An integer property value containing a valid integer number.

NormalLengthListPropertyValue.description: A length list property value containing length values in an array. The values are measured in SI (meters).

NormalLengthPropertyValue.description: A length property value containing a real length value. The value is measured in SI (meters).

NormalMultiEnumPropertyValue.description: A multiple choice enumeration property value containing the IDs of the selected enum values in an array.

NormalNumberListPropertyValue.description: A number list property value containing numbers in an array.

NormalNumberPropertyValue.description: A number property value containing a valid numeric value.

NormalOrUserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A normal or a userUndefined property value.

NormalSingleEnumPropertyValue.description: A single enumeration property value containing the ID of the selected enum value.

NormalStringListPropertyValue.description: A string list property value containing strings in an array.

NormalStringPropertyValue.description: A string property value containing a valid string.

NormalVolumeListPropertyValue.description: A volume list property value containing volumes in an array. The values are measured in SI (cubic meters).

NormalVolumePropertyValue.description: A volume property value containing a real volume. The value is measured in SI (cubic meters).

NotAvailablePropertyValue.description: A notAvailable value means that the property is not available for the property owner (and therefore it has no property value for it).

ObjectDetails.description: Shared shape for Object and Lamp elements (both use the same API_ObjectType struct). lightColor/lightIsOn only apply to Lamps. Per the Archicad SDK's own remarks, per-story visibility (visibility.showRelAbove/showRelBelow) and visibility.linkToSettings.newCreationMode were 'not extended' for Object/Lamp the way they were for other element types - still settable here for schema symmetry, but Archicad may silently ignore them.

useObjectPens.description: Use the pen defined in the library part instead of 'pen'.

useObjectLineTypes.description: Use the line type defined in the library part instead of 'lineTypeId'.

useObjectMaterials.description: Use the materials defined in the library part instead of 'surfaceId'.

useObjectSectionAttributes.description: Use the section attributes defined in the library part instead of 'sectionFillId'/'sectionFillPen'/'sectionFillBackgroundPen'/'sectionContourPen'.

useFixSize.description: Use the A/B (dimensions.x/dimensions.y) values as fixed sizes.

fixPoint.description: 0-based index of the hotspot to keep fixed when the object is resized (raw API_ObjectType.fixPoint value, not 1-based).

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. visibility.description: On Archicad 29 a wall knows only 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories' (Wall Settings offers no Custom option), so a wall can read back a combination the dialog cannot show - a wall fresh from the Wall tool defaults may report showOnHome false with showRelAbove 1, which Wall Settings shows as an empty Show on Stories field (#852). See ModifyWalls for which combinations can be written.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true (the default on a new wall), Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the wall's vertical extent and ignores any value set for it.

contourPen.description: Pen of the wall's own contour/reference outline (API_WallType::contPen) - distinct from cutFillPen, which is the cut fill pattern's pen inherited from the building material/composite/profile. Unlike cutFillPen this is not inheritable/overridable, it is the wall's own pen index directly, the same field used regardless of structureType (Basic, Composite or Profile).

contourPen3D.description: Pen of the wall's contour in 3D views (API_WallType::contPen3D).

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the wall's own contour (API_WallType::contLtype) - pairs with contourPen, which only sets the pen, not the line type.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "OutLines Only" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup (API_WallType::belowViewLineType). Corresponds to the "Uncut Lines" value in the Wall Settings dialog.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup. Corresponds to the "Overhead Line Pens" value in the Wall Settings dialog.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

viewDepthLimitation.description: Only has an effect on a multi-story wall (relativeTopStory/topOffset making it span more than one story).

connectionPriority.description: Priority of the wall in a junction with other elements (API_WallType::wallConnPriority - higher wins the cut/cover at the junction). Archicad ignores writes to this field; read-only in practice.

useCompositePriority.description: When true, the Composite's own priority is used at junctions instead of connectionPriority.

junctionSequence.description: Tie-breaker (0-999) used when two walls meet with the same connectionPriority, or when 3+ walls meet in a junction (API_WallType::sequence). Archicad ignores writes to this field; read-only in practice.

linkToSettings.description: newCreationMode is expected to read back as false after creation; Archicad resolves the relative story selection to an absolute floor index.

inheritEndSurface.description: The end surface of the wall is inherited from the adjoining wall.

alignTexture.description: Align texture mapping to the wall's edges.

offsetFromOutside.description: Distance between the reference line and the outside face of the wall. Output only - not settable via ModifyWalls.

polyCanChange.description: The polygonal wall's corners can be changed in case of L and T connections. Only meaningful for a Polygonal wall (geometryType).

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

logHeight.description: Height of the log for log walls. 0 means a normal (non-log) wall.

hasWindow.description: Whether the wall has at least one Window. Output only.

hasDoor.description: Whether the wall has at least one Door. Output only.

WallModificationGeometryType.description: The wall's plan outline shape, distinct from its cross section shape.

WallModificationProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

WallProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

WallQuantities.description: Quantities of a Wall element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the wall (openings smaller than minOpeningSize are not subtracted).

grossVolume.description: Gross volume of the wall (openings not subtracted).

referenceSideSurface.description: Net surface on the reference line side.

oppositeSideSurface.description: Net surface on the side opposite to the reference line.

edgeSurface.description: Surface of the edges of the wall.

referenceSideSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional surface on the reference line side.

oppositeSideSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional surface on the side opposite to the reference line.

grossReferenceSideSurface.description: Gross surface on the reference line side.

grossOppositeSideSurface.description: Gross surface on the side opposite to the reference line.

length.description: Average of the lengths on the two sides of the wall.

referenceSideLength.description: Length on the reference line side.

oppositeSideLength.description: Length on the side opposite to the reference line.

centerLength.description: Length of the wall at its center.

area.description: Floor plan area of the wall.

perimeter.description: Floor plan perimeter of the wall.

windowsSurface.description: Surface of the windows in the wall.

doorsSurface.description: Surface of the doors in the wall.

emptyOpeningsSurface.description: Surface of the empty openings in the wall.

emptyOpeningsVolume.description: Volume of the empty openings in the wall.

WallReferenceLineLocation.description: The Core* values only have an effect on a Composite or Profile wall (structureType) - a Basic wall has no core skin, and Archicad falls back to the nearest non-core equivalent (e.g. CoreCenter becomes Center).

height.description: height relative to bottom

bottomOffset.description: base level of the wall relative to the floor level

offset.description: wall's base line's offset from ref. line

begThickness.description: Thickness at the beginning in case of trapezoid wall

endThickness.description: Thickness at the end in case of trapezoid wall

height.description: Opening height.

centerOffset.description: Center offset along the owner wall reference line.

reveal.description: Whether the reveal is turned on. The same value ModifyWindows and ModifyDoors take.

revealDepthOffset.description: Distance the frame plane is moved across the wall thickness, along the wall normal. The same value ModifyWindows and ModifyDoors take.

zoneBoundariesOfZones.description: The boundaries of each requested Zone, in the same order as the zones array of the input.

ZoneBoundariesOrError.description: The response of the zone boundaries command or an error.

connectedElementId.description: The unique identifier of the connected element.

isExternal.description: True if the boundary is an external one.

neighbouringZoneElementId.description: Returns the unique identifier of the other Zone the element connects to if the boundary is internal. Please note that this boundary does not represent the boundary of the element with the other Zone.

area.description: The area of the polygon of the boundary.

polygonOutline.description: The outline polygon of the boundary.

ZoneBoundaryPart.description: Section of a wall, beam or curtain wall segment related to a zone.

roomEdgeIndex.description: Index of the zone polygon edge adjacent to the element (not present for beams).

begDistance.description: Beginning distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

endDistance.description: End distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

ZoneCategoryAttributeOrError.description: A zone category attribute or an error.

ZoneCreationGeometry.description: Defines the geometry of a zone. Used as input for creating zones.

name.description: Name of the zone.

categoryAttributeId.description: The identifier of the zone category attribute.

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

isManual.description: Is the coordinates of the zone manually placed?

referencePosition.description: The reference point an automatic zone was placed from (the referencePosition of CreateZones); the zone is found around it when zones are updated. Only present when isManual is false.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the zone.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the zone.

ZoneQuantities.description: Quantities of a Zone element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

calculatedArea.description: Calculated area of the zone (after reductions).

height.description: Height of the zone.

doorsSurface.description: Surface of the doors in the zone.

windowsSurface.description: Surface of the windows in the zone.

ZoneRelations.description: The relations of a zone: the related elements grouped by type and the boundary sections of walls, beams and curtain wall segments.

elementsGroupedByType.description: The elements related to the zone, grouped by element type.

wallParts.description: Sections of walls that border the zone.

beamParts.description: Sections of beams related to the zone.

curtainWallSegmentParts.description: Sections of curtain wall segments that border the zone.

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

referencePosition.description: Moves the reference point of an automatic zone; the zone is found around the new point when zones are next updated. Ignored for a manual zone (isManual true).

Zoom.description: A rectangular zoom box in model coordinates.

xMin.description: The minimum X value of the zoom box.

yMin.description: The minimum Y value of the zoom box.

xMax.description: The maximum X value of the zoom box.

yMax.description: The maximum Y value of the zoom box.
